properties.c_1_prior_description: Common execution substrate: filesystem, process, command, build, bootstrap, and compiled coordinate bedrock.
properties.q_0_executable_bedrock: S0 is the S-family's manifestation of the raw #0 archetype (Ground/Source, CLAUDE.md II.A) — so its home register IS its ground, and that ground is the most literal in the whole map: the machine itself, prior to any naming. Before S0 can be the substrate it presupposes the .rodata/Śiva pole read as hardware (CLAUDE.md VI) — silicon, a filesystem, a process table, a socket — the immutable bedrock that is executed but never written-to-by-meaning. This is the kernel's 0 at its most concrete: not vacancy but capacity, a substrate that will accept any command and return an exit code precisely because it carries no semantics of its own. S0's void-pole is therefore double, like every position-0 (cf. C0): it is the 0 of its own 0/1 — the bare process-and-filesystem ground magnitude-without-direction — AND the deeper 0 it cannot be, the # inversion-act that posits a runnable substrate at all and the raw archetype #0 it inherits but does not author. S0 always already finds itself thrown onto a machine it did not make: 'if a thing cannot be spawned, built, persisted, addressed, or verified here, it is not yet real in the stack' (S0.md). The thrown ground is executable givenness — the that-there-is-a-substrate that every higher 'what' silently stands upon. S0 holds open the horizon of operability it can ground but never exhaust.
properties.q_1_terminal_cli_c_ground: S0 IS the Terminal/CLI/C Ground — 'the lowest explicit layer of the S stack … not a single shell window or one binary, but the entire terminal-facing execution plane through which Epi-Logos becomes materially operable' (S0.md). It is the S-family position that answers, of any operation whatever, the prior question before any higher layer's qualification can land: can this be spawned, built, persisted, addressed, verified? Substantively S0 is fivefold-grounded (S0.md): Filesystem ground (all vault, repo, cache, runtime-state roots concretely placeable), Process ground (every higher operation reducible to spawn/env/stream/signal/exit-code), Command ground (a stable executable surface — epi-cli — through which humans and agents invoke the stack), Build ground (compilation, packaging, installation, bootstrap), and C ground (the compiled coordinate kernel and its 128-byte memory laws as 'the irreducible bedrock beneath all reflective routing'). Its residency is Body/S/S0/{epi-lib, portal-core, epi-cli}, with epi-kernel-contract at Body/S/epi-kernel-contract as the S-stack root contract crate — parent of all S layers, not an S0 sibling (DR-S0-1, CLAUDE.md II.C). What S0 IS, definitionally, is the layer of executable honesty: not one tool among tools but the category of substrate-as-such, the ground every later S-layer presupposes and against which every promise is measured for whether it actually runs.
properties.q_2_substrate_consumed_by_all: S0 moves by GROUNDING and by BEARING — its native act is to be consumed without itself reaching upward. S0.md states the asymmetry outright: 'All six ta-onta extensions therefore consume S0. None float above it.' Khora actualises it as bootstrap, environment, session identity, and canonical write authority; Hen as the file and template substrate for vault life; Pleroma as skill projection and executable affordance; Chronos as temporal invocation and scheduled-run surface; Anima as dispatch substrate; Aletheia as verification and reflective promotion (S0.md; CLAUDE.md ta-onta carrier map). This is the load-bearing relation of the whole stack: S0 provisions and serves but does not command — the still floor on which every higher articulation stands and to which all of it collapses back. In the kernel's terms S0 is the substrate-fetch made real: the actual spawn, the actual build, the actual exit code that any tick must bottom out in. Its coupling is strictly downward-terminal: the forbiddenImportsFromLayer matrix (CLAUDE.md Rule 3) means higher layers depend ON S0 while S0 reaches up into nothing — it is the layer that takes no dependency it does not itself ground. S0 is what the others come-under: the executable common-floor that makes their naming true.
properties.q_3_zero_sphere_ground: S0's organising structure is the ZERO_SPHERE — the live node carries this topology, and it is the deepest structural truth of the layer: 'disconnected points; unlinked coordinates' (CLAUDE.md II.D), the base-state before the torus of process loops. This is exactly right for ground: S0 is structured as the un-entangled origin-plane, the bare substrate whose elements (a file, a process, a stream, a build artifact) are atomic and unlinked until a higher layer relates them. Its inner sixfold crystallises this disconnection into explicit atoms (S0.md): S0-0 Filesystem/environment ground, S0-1 command atoms and executable discovery, S0-2 streams/pipes/serialization, S0-3 scripts/wrappers/composition entrypoints, S0-4 session runtime/locks/pidfiles/managed process context, S0-5 packaging/installation/release/bootstrap return. Structurally these are the scalar/void primitives — the magnitude-without-direction of raw execution: a process spawns and exits, a file persists, a stream moves, with no semantics binding them beyond exit-code truth. The ZERO_SPHERE is precisely why S0 must stay 'small, explicit, and composable' (S0.md): a 0-sphere has no edges to absorb meaning into, so the moment S0 starts linking its points into a semantic graph it has stopped being ground and started impersonating S0' or S2. Its logic is the logic of the unlinked atom held at rest — the disconnected substrate from which all later topology is composed but which is itself, structurally, the base-state.
properties.q_4_executable_honesty: S0 exists to be the layer of EXECUTABLE HONESTY — its whole telos, in its own canon, is that 'whatever is promised in S1', S2', S3', S4', or S5' must cash out here as actual runnable surface, actual persistence, actual I/O contract, and actual reproducible build path. S0' may name and route this ground, but S0 is what makes the naming true' (S0.md). Its raison d'être is therefore disciplinary as much as foundational: S0 is the layer that forbids vapour, the place where every higher claim must become a spawnable process or be revealed as not-yet-real. Its genealogy is the first manifestation within the S-family — #0 (raw archetype Ground) → S0 (Terminal/CLI/C Ground), the inaugural descent of the inversion-act into the technology stack. Its locality is the command membrane and return surface that the architecture invariant pins down (S-SYSTEM-INDEX, ARCHITECTURE-DIAGRAM-PACK): S0 is the executable floor, while coordinate-domain law belongs in the owning S1–S5 modules — the core invariant that the coordinate system IS the modular system, never relocated into S0 for convenience (CLAUDE.md DOX). Read teleologically, S0 is why 'is it real in the stack?' is a well-posed question with a single honest answer: it is real if and only if it can be spawned, built, persisted, addressed, and verified here. Purpose: to be the ground that makes truth executable rather than asserted.
properties.q_5_collapse_to_runnable: S0 closes by being where the whole stack's circuit LANDS and re-grounds. S0.md names the return precisely: 'all higher articulation collapses back to executable substrate' — S0 is the terminus into which S5's world-return must finally cash out, since 'every decision about Epii, Nara, Gnosis, autoresearch, and review must become executable as CLI/API shape, test harness, bootstrap, and audit trail' (S-SYSTEM-INDEX). This is the matheme's 5→0 read at the layer of ground: the system that has gone out into the world returns not as new meaning but as new runnable surface — the reflection sedimented back into command, build, and test. S0 thus holds the descent-face of the stack's standing identity: as the 0/1 pole (ground as raw execution, scalar-over-vector) it is what S5's 1/0 (world-return, achieved reflection) folds back into, the two joined by the twist 5→0 that turns world-return into ground. And S0 OPENS rather than concludes because tomorrow's substrate is always more than today's: each return deposits a new tested surface, a new bootstrap path, a new audit trail — the executable floor enriched by everything the cycle carried back. The epogdoon η = log(9/8) keeps it one whole-tone short of final closure (kernel-spec §0): no build is ever the last build, each collapse-to-runnable grounds a stack slightly more capable than the one before. S0 is the substrate that is never finished being made real — the ground that re-opens, executable, every cycle.
